name: const unsafe fn as_uninit_mut < 'a > (self) -> & 'a mut MaybeUninit < T >
rule: When calling `NonNull<T>::as_uninit_mut`, `self` must be convertible to a reference. Because the returned reference is to `MaybeUninit<T>`, the memory pointed to by `self` need not be initialized.
